title: Ser email threads on Thunderbird mobile
creator: daniel143
content:

Thanks

title: I hope an email translation feature can be added.
creator: nUlL
content: I hope an email translation feature can be added to the application, similar to Gmail's, making it more convenient to translate the content of emails written in foreign languages.
